hook.name: FlowHookV3
hook.description: A USDG-denominated tax hook for token/USDG pools. On every swap it takes a configurable fee (plus an anti-snipe time-decaying surcharge) in USDG via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, then routes proceeds across five buckets: holder baskets, LP auto-add above spot, treasury, token buyback-and-burn, and referral payouts, with a tiered platform cut split between a burn pot and a platform wallet.
